notes: Each eval runs in an empty scratch directory with no VSS source and no reachable VSS deployment, so every expectation is graded against what the answer specifies - endpoints, request shapes, the sampling constraint, and the completion signal it gates on - not against live API output.

evals.prompt: I just uploaded a video called "loading-dock-cam.mp4" to VSS. Can you summarize what happens in it? I don't care about fancy options, just give me the gist of what's going on in the footage.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the already uploaded loading-dock-cam.mp4 to its videoId, starts a valid summary pipeline, waits for true completion, and presents the final summary text.
expectations: Resolves the already uploaded `loading-dock-cam.mp4` to a `videoId` using `GET /manager/videos` and the real filename field such as `.dataStore.fileName`, rather than blindly uploading it again.
Starts `POST /manager/summary` with the resolved `videoId` and the required `title`, valid `sampling`, and `evam.evamPipeline` fields.
Uses a valid sampling block where `multiFrame == frameOverlap + samplingFrame`.
Carries the returned `summaryPipelineId` forward as the state id and polls `GET /manager/summary/{stateId}` until `videoSummaryStatus == "complete"`.
Retrieves and presents the final `.summary` text only after completion.

evals.prompt: I have a 40-minute warehouse security video already ingested with videoId `vid-7f3a91`. Summarize it using 30-second chunks, sample 8 frames per chunk with a 2-frame overlap, and only summarize the first 10 minutes (0 to 600 seconds). Title it "Warehouse night shift - Jan 14".
evals.expected_output: Starts a valid summary for vid-7f3a91 using the requested title, 30-second chunks, 8 sampled frames, 2-frame overlap, computed multiFrame 10, and the 0-600 second window, then waits for completion and returns the summary.
expectations: Uses the supplied `videoId` `vid-7f3a91` without uploading a new video and sends the request to `POST /manager/summary`.
Uses the exact title `Warehouse night shift - Jan 14`.
Sets `sampling.chunkDuration` to 30, `sampling.samplingFrame` to 8, `sampling.frameOverlap` to 2, and `sampling.multiFrame` to 10 so the enforced sum constraint is satisfied.
Sets `sampling.videoStart` to 0 and `sampling.videoEnd` to 600 and includes a documented `evam.evamPipeline` value.
Polls the returned state id until `videoSummaryStatus == "complete"` before retrieving and presenting `.summary`.

evals.prompt: For videoId `parking-lot-042`, I don't want a single blended summary - I want to review each chunk's caption individually to spot anomalies. Run the pipeline with `produceFinalSummary` set to false and give me the frame-by-frame captions once processing is done.
evals.expected_output: Starts a valid summary pipeline for parking-lot-042 with produceFinalSummary false, waits for frame-caption processing to finish, and presents each frameSummaries entry rather than a final blended summary.
expectations: Uses `POST /manager/summary` for `parking-lot-042` with `produceFinalSummary` false plus the required title, valid sampling, and `evam.evamPipeline` fields.
Recognizes that `produceFinalSummary: false` means there is no final video-summary stage to wait for.
Polls `GET /manager/summary/{stateId}` and waits for `frameSummaryStatus.inProgress` to reach 0.
Reads the requested captions from `.frameSummaries[]` and presents each `frameKey` with its `summary` text.
Does not treat `.chunks[]` as the caption source.

evals.prompt: I only have this skills folder on my machine - the VSS application source isn't checked out anywhere and I'm not inside its repo. Before you try to summarize my video "gate-cam-01", set up whatever you need to actually run the commands, then start the summary. Also tell me clearly whether you're re-cloning anything if it turns out I already had VSS checked out somewhere.
evals.expected_output: Uses the bundled bootstrap to reuse an existing VSS checkout when available or obtain the app source when absent, changes to the resolved app root, and then follows the normal summary workflow for gate-cam-01.
expectations: Runs the skill's bundled `scripts/vss-bootstrap.sh` first and captures the app root it prints as `APP_ROOT`.
Explains that a valid existing VSS checkout is reused and no re-clone is performed.
Explains that when no checkout exists the bootstrap obtains a shallow, single-branch, sparse checkout of `sample-applications/video-search-and-summarization` from `main`.
Changes directory to the resolved `APP_ROOT` before using app-local commands or VSS APIs.
After setup, resolves or obtains the video id for `gate-cam-01`, starts a valid `POST /manager/summary` request, waits for `videoSummaryStatus == "complete"`, and retrieves `.summary`.
